title: Quest text for 'Perrin's Mother' ('Tell his mother in Reedholm, as you promised her') stays listed as a live, biddable promise all the way to the end screen, but the moment you cross the one-way Pass Gate toward Marrowgate it becomes physically impossible to fulfil; the gate's warning is generic ('a companion's grief left unfinished... stays unfinished') and never names which specific standing promises are about to be stranded.
